اجتنبوا (form VIII)
# اِجْتَنَبُوا (ijtanabū) /id͡ʒ.ta.na.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# اُجْتُنِبُوا (ujtunibū) /ud͡ʒ.tu.ni.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# اِجْتَنِبُوا (ijtanibū) /id͡ʒ.ta.ni.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
